mentions.name: MusicLibrarian
mentions.description: A free macOS app that cleans up Apple Music libraries. It detects duplicate tracks via ISRC codes, fixes metadata, and identifies tracks that are available in lossless quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building MusicLibrarian, it's a macOS app to clean up Apple Music libraries. Detects duplicates via ISRC codes, fixes metadata, identifies tracks available in lossless. Free at thevaultdj.com
